1. Download the form from KP ERP

concession application form within the period notified to you by email.

card and attendance report. Incomplete or incorrect forms will be rejected without
review.

before the stated deadline. BSc and BA triple major students should submit to the
Department-in-charge. Forms are not accepted after the closing date.

Your School's Dean reviews and approves eligible applications, then forwards the
consolidated list and hard copies to the Scholarship & Fellowship Support Cell
(SSC).

If approved, the SSC (Room 206, Second Floor, Central Block, Bangalore Central Campus)
will email you and issue a Fee Concession Voucher.
6. Collect revised demand slip from Accounts
Take your Fee Concession Voucher to the Office of Accounts, Central Block, to obtain a
revised demand slip showing the balance payable.

Ongoing Obligations
1. Form C — if living off-campus
If you reside in a PG accommodation or private apartment, your landlord must
fill and submit Form C online at indianfrro.gov.in/frro/FormC. For students in
University Halls (St Kuriakose Hall, Devadan Hall, Jonas Hall, Christ Hall),
Form C is handled by the OIA.
2. Monitor your e-FRRO account regularly
Log in to your registered e-FRRO portal account periodically to check for
messages or requests from the FRRO regarding your Residential Permit
application.
3. Update address changes within 14 days
Any change in your residential address must be updated on the e-FRRO portal
within 14 days of moving
4. Deposit a copy of your Residential Permit with OIA
Once your Residential Permit is obtained from the FRRO, deposit a copy with
the Office of International Affairs at the University.
5. Renew Student Visa and Residential Permit well in advance
Apply for renewal before expiry to avoid a late fine of US $300. If the Residential
Permit is not renewed within 3 months of expiry, you may be deported by
Government authorities.
Note: Bonafide Letters & Certificates for FRRO or visa purposes can be collected from the Office
of International Affairs.
